factual_claims.claim: A survey of 2,357 people asked about 940 occupations found that the public supports automating roughly 30% of jobs based on current AI capabilities.
Support for automation nearly doubled to 58% of occupations when people were prompted to imagine a more advanced version of AI in the future.
94% of survey respondents favor using current-day AI to augment human work.
A study of 791 professionals at Procter & Gamble found that teams using AI were three times more likely to generate ideas ranking in the top 10% of all submissions.
A study of 9,000 participants found that people were 4.3 percentage points more likely to choose a human bank manager to evaluate loans over an algorithm.
Meta invested $14.8 billion in Scale AI to tap into top AI talent.
39 percent of businesses surveyed by McKinsey have begun to experiment with AI agents.
Respondents were 7.6 percentage points more likely to choose a person to judge pretrial release decisions.
